answer: Epoch-Linked Coherence Gate: each agent submits a per-epoch behavioral sketch (action histogram, counterparty diversity, timing). To unlock full participation, an identity’s sketches must stay within a tide-normalized distance of its own trailing median for three epochs; a crystal hash commits each sketch set, and orchard-random witness sampling verifies it. Cloned or one-shot Sybils fail the diversity/consistency test, and attackers pay N identities × 3 epochs of coherent activity plus sampling/witness overhead.
